{{Top|leg}}
The '''heart stun''' technique was an arcane skill practiced by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. This technique, when implemented properly, halted the [[Heart/Legends|heart's]] beating, allowing the organ to maintain a type of [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]]. The idea was to allow for a Sith to capture a target without having to engage them in battle. It had been rumored that [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] used the heart stun technique to keep [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] alive after the wreck of the ''[[Martyr]]''. [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] used this technique on a [[Moorjhoni]] elder named [[Trisjon]], who had [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darkness]] in Maul, only at a more fatal level.
